audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart's two layers disagree: content win[2]/win[3] say "Skill" and win[6] says "Sona", but full phases[2]/[3].side say "Hwei" and phases[6].side says "Skill" — three rows contradicting the content layer's own text (whys[2]/whys[3] describe an even lane, whys[6] describes Sona pulling ahead).
audit.why: whys[2] states the lane evens out at 3 as Sona gets Aria heal + Power Chord; whys[3] states levels 4-5 stay skill-based; whys[6] states 2+ items go to Sona via auras and AoE Crescendo. The full-layer side/why fields never picked this up and stayed on a generic Hwei-favoured template.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[2].side and phases[3].side to Skill and phases[6].side to Sona, rewriting each .why to match, since content win[N] already held the correct verdict — only the full layer needed to move.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Crescendo as matchup-defining but has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never mentions that Sona's W (Aria) is a flat 10s heal/shield that should be baited before committing.
audit.why: Kit gives real numbers: Sona R is 140/120/100s, W is a flat 10s that heals only herself plus one wounded ally. missingInteractions flags both the anti-heal timing on W and that W absorbs burst.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldown numbers and the W heal/shield trigger to breakdown.cooldowns, and rewrote dontsFull[1].d (previously a mismatched fear/Flash line under a "Trade at shield windows" title) to actually describe Sona's shield.

audit.why: Power spikes are accurate: level 2 (Hwei's second ability online before Sona has waveclear), level 6 (R outranges Crescendo), first item (burst poke beats single-target heal), late (Sona's auras/AoE stun scale past 2v2 poke).

edits.before: Full palette: EE fear or EQ root into QQ — the support slot's longest pick kit.
edits.after: Sona's Aria heal and Power Chord give her the tools to trade back — the lead evens out here.

edits.before: Mark-detonate the margins and bank Manaflow — the chip war is a gallery show.

edits.before: Late support Hwei opens fights: R the carry, fear the choke, and root whatever the slow catches.
edits.after: Her auras and AoE Crescendo scale past your two-person poke into the mid-game past two items.

edits.before: - Sona Crescendo: matchup-defining — The stun chord flips grouped fights — spread while it is up. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E fear paint banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Sona's Crescendo is 140/120/100s — the stun chord flips grouped fights, so spread while it's up. - Her W (Aria) is a flat 10s; it only heals her plus one ally, so force it out before you commit. - Keep E fear paint banked for her best play.

edits.before: QQ the pair, any second paint for the mark, detonate — gallery math their duo can't price.

edits.after: Commit on Crescendo’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: You own levels 1-2: Sona has zero waveclear and thin base sustain, so you shove the first wave, hit level 2 first, and land E-Q poke while she's exposed last-hitting. Keep her away from Power Chord procs and she bleeds HP fast.
edits.after: You own levels 1-2: Sona has zero waveclear and thin base sustain, so you shove the first wave, hit level 2 first, and land E-Q poke while she's exposed last-hitting. Her Power Chord reset shows on the auto wind-up — step back on that, not the cast.

Fixed all 5 lintFindings (2 bleeds, 2 misgenders, 1 missing digit). Folded 3 of 4 missingInteractions (anti-heal timing, shield-absorbs-burst, autoreset tell) into existing fields; onhit-itemization was judged already adequately covered by existing wants.you[2]/wants.foe[1] text about Power Chord procs, so no edit made there — noted here rather than forced.
